Better yet, it is able to do this while balancing your moisture levels so that you don?™t dry out like crazy. This lactic acid product specifically is my favorite and you can?™t beat the price! This mask does wonders. They next day after using the mask my face is glowing! It removes some pesky flakes and leave my face smooth. There is a strong orange scent that you can sorta smell when it?™s on your face but I don?™t mind it.

This is a lovely mask. I used the sample I received after cleansing with a cleanser from a different line, which was horribly drying. The mask goes on a little sticky and gritty and the smell is not the nicest. But the result was beautiful. My skin felt much more hydrated, smoother, and looked brighter and refreshed. I am so happy I found this product! I used to get glycolic or lactic facials every two weeks at my dermatologist. Since finding out I was pregnant 5 months ago, I have stopped getting facials because they are very expensive. Due to pregnancy hormones and the lack of professionally done facials, my skin has not looked very good. However, I finally have that glow pregnant women are supposed to have because I am using REN glycol lactic radiance renewal mask 2-3x a week. It keeps my pores clean and unclogged because I believe the ingredients speed up the regeneration process of skin cells, therefore sloughing off dead skin before pores become clogged. It also helps with my hyper pigmentation (acne scars), skin-tone evenness, and hydrates my skin. I started getting smile marks after I stopped getting facials every other week and they were very noticeable when I wore makeup. My smile marks/wrinkles have disappeared because the mask gets rid of dead skin and makes my skin soft and supple. I never write reviews, but I wanted to praise this product because it has worked so well for me. The price of this mask is so cheap...considering the amount of $$$ I used to spend on facials. A little bit of product goes a long way so the bottle will last a long time. I got 3-4 uses out of the sample I received from Sephora before I purchased it . Tip: if you are unsure about spending the $$$, don?™t forget you can get a sample to try at home BEFORE you buy the entire bottle. I bought the Glam Glow super mud mask and had to return it after 2 uses because my skin had a bad reaction to it. At the time I purchased Glam Glow, I was also given a sample of this REN glycol mask, and I?™m so happy I found the product because it addresses every Skincare issue/need I have.

Just wanted to write a quick review on my experience because I have sensitive skin. I got this as a sample and was like ?œooh a mask! Yay!??Because I love trying face masks. I didn?™t read it wasn?™t for sensitive skin but I applied cautiously cause it says glycol lactic in the name. Anyways, I?™ve been able to get 3 uses out of this sample. I think I?™ll get one more. And have learned to use it and get the effects without irritating my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin which hasn?™t been able to tolerate other products but this for some reason works. How do I use it? To protect the sensitive areas I just apply a very thin layer. And then follow as directed. And I get wonderful results.
I never noticed any real changes to my skin. However, it made my face feel very clean and fresh for the day.
I didnt notice much improvement on anything that they claimed was going to improve...i will try again to see but for rigth now its just like a simple exfoliation benefits. Thats it.

Last month I went to my local Sephora to discuss my skin woes. At my wits end dealing with the effects of early menopause (rosacea,wrinkles, and breakouts!) I was looking for a mask to address my issues and was directed to this product. At home I put it on, with my feet up and a glass of wine in hand, and 10 minutes later I was glowing! I?™ve been using it regularly and am loving the results. Had my makeup professionally done for my birthday and she said my skin was radiant and at least 10 years younger than my age! Wanted to know what I was using. This is a keeper,

I got a deluxe sample size of this mask when i worked at Sephora. I have to say, I wasn?™t excited to try it mainly, because I find the aesthetics of REN?™s line to be very cheap-looking and generally uninspiring. I guess I shouldn?™t judge a book by its cover. This mask it awesome. It does sting some, but I don?™t mind a little stinging. I see it as my the product delivering an effective (but not too strong) dose of active ingredients. I recently moved from the country to the big city of New York about 7 months ago. Not only was the air pollution at a all time high for my skin, there were also stress involved. I literally have tried everything under the sun to clear up my sudden severe acne that I had gotten from moving here. Last week I told the Sephora employee that I was fed up with trying acne medications, spot treatments, so on and so forth. She then became super excited and knew EXACTLY what to recommend to me because, she too, had similar skin problems in the past. She showed me this product and felt as though it would be great for me because of the fruit extract acids (I?™ve been trying to go all natural with Skincare) and the easy application... I?™ll have to say it is gooey and honey-like but it?™s honestly something that I enjoy! Plus the smell is great. The first night I did my routine of taking off makeup with olive oil and cleaning with my Eminance Cleanser (they sell this in spas) then did a spot treatment of Tea Tree Oil and left the mask on over night. In the morning when I took the mask off I was completely amazed!! Not only was the congestion reduced by 50% but by day 3 my redness had gone down and my overall skin tone was more even. Will definitely be buying this product again because it finished my skin routine. Again, I have never had acne prone skin until moving into the city and this stuff saved me. Thank you Sephora and Ren products!!!

I love this mask. After the mask my face is smooth and clean

at first i wasn?™t to keen on this product and had meade up my mind within a weel or 2 that i wasn?™t going to buy again. didn?™t want to waste my money so i kept using the product and id say by week 4 i really saw my skin more radiant than ever! this mask does what it says it does -- but you have to be okay with a REALLY viscous, sticky-feeling product on your face for a long while. the texture is very uncomfortable for me, and drives me crazy while i have it on, but there?™s no denying that it works. i would give it five stars except for that one thing. I received a sample of this product and decided to give it a try......my skin was smoother and alittle more radiant after just one use it was a nice surprise!
I love this mask! The consistency is really sticky, but it works well and makes my skin feel nice and smooth and gives a tiny bit of a glow. I get no breakouts from this which is awesome as well.

Doesn?™t irritate the skin.I have a trial size.Will add it to my beauty routine.

I love this mask! After using this mask, I found my skin radiant and the tone is more even. It also hydrates the skin and keep it supple. I think this is one of the best masks I have ever used and will definitely repurchase!
After using it I realized my skin looked radiant. But I realized a pattern of breaking out each time I used this and I don?™t think I can use this anymore.
Absolutely love esp after a breakout. Brightens you up!

While this product felt good on my face and left my skin feeling a little refreshed, it didn?™t do much else. It was nice to try out, but I don?™t think this product is for me. The smell didn?™t bother me, but was a little different, kind of like a ?œnew home??smell.

Pros: works well with my sensitive skin, good amount of products, noticeable results with weekly useCons: kind of expensive, texture is a little gooeyWill probably re-purchase as this product is great for my sensitive/dry skin. I received this as a deluxe sample, and such little does go a very long way,I still have at least a half dozen uses left. They are correct, it is NOT for sensitive skin, I do not hve sensitive skin and the tingle got very intense and almost a hot feeling aroung 10 minutes,I did notice it cleaned my skin very well ( I had makeup on in 90 + degree weather and dirt/rust from being with my mechanic as he worked on my car , explaining what needed done) I did notice my pores were very clean under intense light and magnification. I waited to write this review until I had used this mask for a full four weeks to let my skin adjust and see actual results. For a little background I use prescription acne medication and retinol cream because of hormonal acne problems, which have greatly cleared up my face but I have a lot of purple and red pigmentation left over from breakouts. I bought this for that, skin clearing purpose, and because I felt my skintone was all around just dull.I have now used it every week for four consecutive weeks and I am beyond impressed. Although its called a mask it reminds me more of a peel. I did experience breakouts the first two weeks and they have progressively gotten less each application, but I will say they were blemishes I could feel under my skin before ever using the mask. I cannot give this enough praise!! My skin has not looked this good in so long! My skintone is so much clearer and brighter. With and without makeup on my skin looks so healthy and glowing. My pigmentation has SIGNIFICANTLY lightened and peeled off and I still have much more than half the bottle left (I use about a pump and a half each time). This is well worth the money especially compared to doing salon services. Its worth the initial peeling and breakouts, because my skin wasnt looking that good anyways. column10: I received this as part of Influenster?™s campaign. I would like to preemptively apologize for my review. Jar packaging isn?™t optimal for the stability of some of the extracts, but it?™s not the biggest issue because it does contain the preservative phenoxyethanol. Preservatives can be irritating to some but is a necessary component to prevent bacterial overgrowth. Most of the hero ingredients come after the questionable/problematic ingredients. Fragrant essential oils can oxidize when exposed to UV light and cause inflammation and hyperpigmentation, so that does give me some pause. Religiously wearing sunscreen is a MUST if you use this during the day. Fragrance, natural or synthetic, just isn?™t great in the long-term and should be avoided if 1) you have sensitive skin, or 2) are serious about skin health in the long-term. It has a nice gel-cream texture, but leaves your skin feeling parched. This is despite the inclusion of water-binding ingredients. Some of the ingredients are rich in polysaccharides, which make for wonderful humectants. It even contains sodium hyaluronate. My best guess as to why some people will feel stripped by this is because of a combination of astringent witch hazel, drying alcohol, and possibly a depleted skin barrier as result of a bad reaction to essential oils. I only used it on my face a few times because I do use vitamin c and retinol- powerful actives don?™t play well with essential oils because they are co-irritants. I did use this on my hands and they honestly felt so stripped of moisture even with a generous layer. This really isn?™t for me, even as someone with combination skin. I would remove the essential oils and let the star ingredients shine: salicylic acid, marine algae extracts, and a few other surprises that aren?™t highlighted in the marketing. Although this is not a product that my skin appreciates, if this works for you then wonderful! Whatever it takes to make you feel happy in your own skin.

I was looking at the ingredient list and was a little disappointed to see that the second most high content ingredient in this moisturizer was dimethicone. Dimethicone is a super common used ingredient in many of our facial products. Sometimes it is found in lip balms, but its also in cosmetics like the Porefessional by Benefit and skincare items such as the Origins Original Skin Matte Moisturizer. When it comes to this ingredient (it is a silicon based polymer) I would be absolutely sure that your skin is completely clean before application. Dimethicone can help with moisturizing the skin and trapping in all essential nutrients, but it can also trap sebum, excess oil, the exposed contents of a pimple-dead white blood cells, sebum, and bacteria. So be absolutely sure that your skin is very cleansed before using this item. I really like the scent too, it smells of lavender, and lightly of lemongrass-but if you are extremely sensitive to smells, this will not harm it. I take off one star because the price is quite high, and when I began using this cream I got very itchy after application on my chin!
